Grade: PP1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: NUMBERS 2.1 Rote counting By the end of the sub-strand, the • Guide learners to 
Topic 2.2: Number recognition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Number recognition
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. solve questions on Number recognition
2. show clear working for Number recognition

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Learning Number recognition

• Read the meaning of Number recognition.
• Copy every worked example into your book.
• Then solve the Try this questions without looking.

▸ Number recognition

Teach
• Use objects, drawings, or place value to understand Number recognition.
• Write each step. Box the final answer.

Worked example
• Model question on Number recognition: write the question.
• Step 1: …
• Step 2: …
• Answer: …
• (Your teacher/parent can replace this with the class example.)

Try this
• Invent 3 Number recognition questions using Kenyan shillings, metres, or classroom counts.
• Solve all three and show working.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Show working for one Number recognition question.
• Check with a second method.

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Solve 8 practice questions on Number recognition.
2. Mark and correct mistakes.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a revision sheet for Number recognition with 5 worked examples.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Show working.
• Check every answer.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
